title: Thai Combination Fried Rice
description: A Thai-inspired fried rice dish with tofu, eggs, vegetables, fish sauce, and jasmine rice, cooked quickly in a hot wok.

ingredients.name: carrot
ingredients.quantity: 1 large, peeled and diced or julienned

ingredients.name: tofu
ingredients.quantity: 4 ounces, patted dry and cut into 1/2-inch cubes

ingredients.name: eggs
ingredients.quantity: 4, beaten and seasoned with salt and pepper

steps.instruction: If needed, prepare the jasmine rice ahead of time and chill it so you have 5 cups cooked rice ready.
Prepare all ingredients before cooking: mince the garlic, cut the carrot, cube the tofu, beat the eggs, chop the tomato and scallions.
Heat a large wok or heavy skillet over medium-high heat until very hot.
Add the oil and swirl to coat the pan.
Add the carrot and tofu, stir-frying until lightly browned, about 2 minutes.
Add the garlic and stir-fry until golden, about 30 seconds.
Pour in the beaten eggs and scramble until just cooked.
Add the cooked rice and stir-fry, pressing and tossing it repeatedly, for about 2 minutes.
Add the fish sauce, chile sauce, tomato, and scallions, then stir-fry for about 30 seconds.
Serve immediately, garnished with cilantro and cucumber, with lime wedges and extra fish sauce on the side.
